Dear Mr Hadley,

Thank you for getting back to us. We're glad you're open to discussing a renewal, and we would very much like to stay for another year.

We have always paid on time over the last three years, and we're really hoping to keep the rent at the current £1,250 per month. Continuing the tenancy also avoids the cost and hassle of finding new tenants or having a gap between lets.

Staying here is definitely our first choice, so we would much rather agree on a renewal with you than have to look elsewhere, though of course it will depend on the rent. If you had something specific in mind, please let us know and we can take it from there.

Many thanks.
